properties.displayName: CoreWCF: UnixDomainSocket Non-Reentrant POSIX Identity Resolution
properties.description: CoreWCF: UnixDomainSocket Non-Reentrant POSIX Identity Resolution
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "corewcf" or CommandLine contains "unixdomainsocket" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 3 // GHADV-1994
